data.one_liner: Converts raw Dart values into human-friendly representations.
data.what_it_does: A library that converts raw Dart values into readable formats for users. It supports approximate time formatting, cardinal and ordinal numbers, plurality, string casing and truncation, programming symbols, and units of measurement.
use_when: You need to display approximate relative time from a Duration
You need to format numbers into cardinal or ordinal text
You need to humanize units of measurement or large numbers
avoid_when: You require robust multilingual localization beyond English
You only need standard intl formatting without extra humanizer extensions
strengths: Broad API surface covering times, numbers, strings, and units
Allows running calculations without loss of precision using Rational
weaknesses: Currently only includes an English implementation despite being locale-aware

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: For standard internationalization, date formatting, and translation features provided by the official Dart and Flutter teams.

alternatives.name: timeago
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need time ago formatting with extensive multi-language support.
